svg.title: Tree-augmented naive Bayes
svg.desc: Structure of a tree-augmented naive Bayes classifier over 4 variables: 3 variables depend on a parent variable as well as on the class. Each such variable is normal within a class with a mean linear in its parent; the edge label gives that slope for class 0 / class 1.
svg.text: The class and at most one other variable are the parents of each variable

g.class: mk n0 nd s0 j1 j2 j3 j4
